# The Sounding Caves

*The sea caves under Goa Harbour's cliffs, where the water booms and, at the far end, moves when it should be still. Its creatures meet you at your own level.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Levels | 20-70 |
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour.md) |
